sql: select timestamp, event_message from logs where (event_message like '%video%' or event_message like '%Video%' or event_message like '%Z-API%' or event_message like '%zapi%' or event_message like '%AI Agent%' or event_message like '%Bot Materials%' or event_message like '%status%' or event_message like '%MessageStatus%') and event_message not like 'GET |%' and event_message not like 'POST |%' and event_message not like 'PATCH |%' order by timestamp asc limit 500
